summary: Backend engineer with two years of experience building payment APIs in Go and Postgres. Cut checkout failures by 38% at a 40-person fintech and enjoy making slow systems boring and fast.

Wrote the on-call runbook and alert rules that dropped weekly pages from 25 to 7
Built an internal invoice-matching tool in Python used by a 6-person finance team every week
Added Postgres indexes that took the slowest report from 41 seconds to 3
